title: ANTIGONE: Accurate Navigation Path Caching in Dynamic Road Networks leveraging Route APIs
motivation: Querying route APIs costs >$1M/year; >50% paths not updated >6 months, causing inaccurate ETA and poor QoS for food delivery platforms.
problem_framing: Minimize weighted average inconsistency error γ_t subject to fixed query budget per time-window; NP-Hard set cover problem.
key_insight: Querying multi-hop OD paths costs same as single edge, so selecting long paths maximizes edge coverage per dollar; regular traffic patterns enable prediction-based prioritization.
method_signature: Hybrid graph compression + UCB-based path selection + predictor correction + courier trace seeding
evaluation_criteria: Inconsistency error (γ_t) and query cost savings vs Delay&Visit baseline
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Predictor-based ANTIGONE error increases initially, requires 3 days to build effective predictors; courier traces are noisy (97% precision rider state classification).
evidence_for_taste: cost is invariable to the length
simplified update saves lots of overhead
thinking_moves: 把多跳路径查询等价于单边查询以扩大覆盖
利用出行时间的日周期规律性建立预测器
将路径更新问题形式化为集合覆盖并用贪心近似
引入多臂老虎机框架平衡探索与利用
用快递员轨迹替代API查询获取实时路径
